public_rationale: The claim says that in early January 2024, Bing answered yes when Katie Conrad asked whether its DC-like images were original, and that this answer was untrue. The evidence packet contains no evidence items. The search found the authors' own post and a later post by Conrad. Both come from the speaker's side, so neither counts as independent evidence under the contract. Two other sources were set aside because they cover a different incident or only give general background. The packet records no independent report, archive or Microsoft statement about this exchange or the images. With no independent record either way, the claim can be neither supported nor contradicted.
limitations: The packet has no independent record of Bing's reply or of the generated images.
The post's screenshots are images the reviewer could not read, so their content was not checked.
The packet notes that a chat session like this cannot be replayed, so running the same prompt now would not show what Bing said in January 2024.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Bing falsely said its apparently infringing images were original.

statement.excerpt: Notice, too, that Katie asked Bing “are they original?”, and Bing, untruthfully, but with a cozy emoticon, answered in the affirmative.
statement.document_title: DALL-E’s New Guardrails: Fast, Furious, and Far from Airtight

from_speaker: images were apparent copyright infringements (DC Comics characters)
our_interpretation: Read as two parts: (1) in a Bing chat (Copilot with DALL-E 3) in early January 2024, Bing said yes when asked whether its generated images were original; (2) the images closely reproduced existing DC Comics characters, so the 'yes' was untrue.
The target period is the days before the post. Marcus and Southen's examples came out in early January 2024, and the post is dated 2024-01-10.
criteria.support_condition: An independent record of the exchange (a screenshot or transcript not from the authors, or a news report that saw it) showing Bing calling the images original, plus images that clearly copy a pre-existing DC character.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independent record showing Bing did not affirm originality, or that the images in question did not resemble existing DC characters.
